thread:
maya: Heads up — I found Gerald (the lobster plush) in the kitchen under a stack of pizza boxes. He has a tiny Post-it that says 'on loan'. 😂

trevor: NO WAY. Gerald went missing during the hackathon 2022. Legend said he ascended to the server rack.

kelly: Wait which Gerald? The lobster or the inflatable flamingo? we have multiple mascots now. :flamingo: :lobster:

maya: Lobster Gerald. He was wearing a sticker that said `team: optimizer` so I'm assuming provenance.

samir: Please photograph for the archive. This is Redwood anthropology. :camera_flash:

maya: https://img.redwood.internal/gerald_found.jpg (blurry but iconic)

nina: omg the tiny Post-it handwriting looks like _trevor_. :point_up: suspect.

trevor: Deny deny deny. I will say only: I may have once used Gerald as a whiteboard pointer during an all-hands. :sweat_smile:

kelly: Council votes? Do we ceremonially reunite Gerald with Phil (the office fern) or start a Gerald shrine near the snack drawer?

samir: Poll: `Where should Gerald live?`
keln: (typo) meant to say kelly

ops-bot: POLL CREATED: Where should Gerald live? 
- Desk of the original owner
- Near the snack drawer (high traffic)
- On the observability shelf (for good metrics)
- Gerald's private tiny office (locked)

maya: Votes: snack drawer +1

trevor: observability shelf +1 (he demands low latency)

nina: tiny office +1 (also provide miniature plant)

samir: desk of original owner +1 (we should find owner first)

kelly: Also can we start a Gerald lore channel? I feel like this is the start of a saga. :open_book:

maya: If we do, tagline: 'Gerald: keeper of forgotten lunch coupons'

trevor: also side note — if anyone actually claims him, speak now. Otherwise he becomes a company heirloom.

nina: I'll volunteer to be interim curator. I promise to feed him protein-free snacks. :seedling: :lobster:

samir: Official motion: put Gerald on the snack shelf for now, take a ceremonial photo, then if nobody claims him in 2 weeks he joins the lore. Seconded. :thumbsup:

maya: Photo uploaded to #random-gallery and pinned. Ritual complete. :tada:

ops-bot: REMINDER: Lost & Found policy: items unclaimed after 14 days may be repurposed by the community.

trevor: Looks like Gerald's fate is sealed. Long live Gerald the Lobster.

kelly: Long live the lobster. :crown:
